en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large, ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century courthouse or justice building on a city street. The multi‑storey structure has elaborate facades, steep roofs with dormers and finials, and arched windows; trees without leaves line the sidewalk and a few pedestrians walk along the street. The back of the card has typical divided postcard layout and printed captions in multiple languages.
